clue.text: It should deflect spear, with battle raging

definitions.text: It should deflect spear, with battle raging

indicators.note: raging describes a battle in turmoil, so the letters of the two words are thrown into disorder

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A soldier's armour is praised for turning aside a spear in the thick of the fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raging' makes an anagram of SPEAR and BATTLE together, and the whole clue also describes the armour, so it is an all-in-one clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of armour covering the chest is exactly what would turn aside a thrust weapon in combat.

clue.text: Black music selection for dance

parts.note: B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils
op. (opus) is a numbered work in a composer's catalogue

explanation.surface: Someone picks out some black music to dance to.
explanation.definitionFit: Bop is a lively jazz style and also an informal word for dancing to pop music.

clue.text: Land alien nursing severe pain

indicators.note: nursing means holding something close, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: ET is the film alien, the Extra-Terrestrial
gyp is British slang for sharp pain, as in 'my knee is giving me gyp'

explanation.surface: An alien creature tends a country through great suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: GYP is British slang for pain ('giving me gyp').
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt is a country, and a land is a nation or state.

clue.text: I brought in identical, extremely strange, sort of twins

indicators.note: brought in means introduced into, so the letter I goes inside the word for identical

parts.note: identical means the same

indicators.note: extremely points to the outermost letters of the word strange

explanation.surface: Twins described as identical yet extremely strange are brought into the story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes the first and last letters of 'strange', S and E.
explanation.definitionFit: Conjoined twins were once commonly called by this name after the famous pair Chang and Eng from Siam.

clue.text: Walking stick is comparatively plain

definitions.meaning: a staff with a metal spike at the tip, used for walking
the simile 'as plain as a ___' compares something obvious to this object

explanation.surface: A walking cane is described as rather ordinary.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense relies on the idiom 'as plain as a pikestaff', meaning perfectly obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: A pikestaff is a spiked walking pole, and the stock simile uses it as the measure of obviousness.

clue.text: Greek may be offered top-flight accommodation

definitions.meaning: Of Athens, the classical Greek dialect or region
a room in the roof space, at the very top of the stairs

explanation.surface: A Greek visitor might be given a smart room at the top of a hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top-flight' looks like praise for quality but means at the top of the flights of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Attica is the region around Athens, and a loft room sits at the top of a house.

clue.text: In Latin, I blunder -a vain experience

parts.note: ego is the Latin word for I
to trip is to make a slip or mistake

explanation.surface: In Latin class, a pupil confesses a mistake, an empty experience.
explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is an activity undertaken purely for self-gratification or vanity.

clue.text: Part of flock sitting here? Bird abandons it

indicators.note: abandons means leaves behind, so the word it is removed from the bird

parts.note: the pewit is another name for the lapwing

explanation.surface: A bird flies off, leaving part of its flock behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flock' suggests birds, but here it is a church congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: A church congregation is a flock, and members sit on long benches in the nave.

clue.text: Man coming before me parking on blinking light

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
re means on or concerning, as in business letters
a cursor is the flashing marker on a computer screen

explanation.surface: A man drives ahead of the speaker and parks under a flashing light.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition echoes John the Baptist, who came before Christ.
explanation.definitionFit: A forerunner who arrives ahead of someone else and heralds them is a precursor.

clue.text: Needed cash enclosed, breaking rule drawn up

indicators.note: breaking means splitting open, so one piece is set inside the other
in a down clue, drawn up means read from bottom to top, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a law is a rule
herewith means enclosed with this letter, in formal correspondence

explanation.surface: Money needed is enclosed with a letter that breaks a rule someone drafted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawn up' gives WAL, since down entries are read upward, and 'breaking' splits it around a word from formal business letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The wherewithal is the means, especially money, needed for a purpose.

clue.text: Shrilly complain about boat — screw loose in it?

indicators.note: about signals turning round, so the word for shrill complaining is read backwards

parts.note: to yap is to bark or complain in a shrill voice
a packet is a packet boat, a mail ship

explanation.surface: Someone moans shrilly about a boat that has a loose screw in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'screw' is British slang for wages, so loose screw is cash carried in a wage envelope.
explanation.definitionFit: Wages, slangily a screw, were once handed out as cash inside an envelope.

clue.text: Farm animal I called Daisy

parts.note: an ox is a farm animal

indicators.note: called means spoken, so the word is taken for its sound

parts.note: the letter I sounds the same as eye

explanation.surface: A farmer names one of the animals Daisy.
explanation.walkthrough: Daisy looks like the cow's name, but it is the definition: a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxeye is a large white wild daisy.

clue.text: Uncovered animosities son getting over first sign of love?

indicators.note: getting over is taken as covering, so the hatreds and son wrap around a letter

parts.note: animosities are hates

indicators.note: first sign of picks the opening letter of the word love

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son in genealogies

explanation.surface: Hatreds and a son are overcome by the first sign of love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first sign of' takes L from love, and 'getting over' places HATES plus S around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no hat on is having the head bare.

clue.text: I see why four may struggle in domestic work

indicators.note: struggle suggests writhing and twisting, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone wonders why four people find household chores a struggle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may struggle' rearranges the letters of I SEE WHY FOUR.
explanation.definitionFit: Housewifery is the running of a home, its cleaning and cooking.

clue.text: Drink a lot, or nothing, when involved in driving?

indicators.note: involved in means wrapped up within, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: driving is the use of a car, so read as car use
O is the round figure zero

explanation.surface: A question of whether to drink heavily or not at all when driving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driving?' stands for CAR USE, and O for nothing goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To carouse is to drink heavily and make merry.

clue.text: Practice one learned after university

indicators.note: after means the following piece comes later in the answer

parts.note: a sage is a wise or learned person

explanation.surface: A learned person studies practice after university.
explanation.definitionFit: Usage is custom or established practice, as in long usage.

clue.text: Liking to bring up third of 17 in battle

indicators.note: in places the reversed letters within the word for battle

parts.note: action is military combat

indicators.note: in a down clue, bring up means raise from bottom to top, so the letters reverse

parts.note: the third letter of the answer at 17 across is F, spelled out as eff

explanation.surface: A fondness for raising a letter from a nearby answer in the heat of battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to bring up' gives FFE in a down entry, and 'in' sets it after the first letter of the battle word; a letter of the alphabet is spelled out as a word.
explanation.definitionFit: Affection is warm fondness for someone.

clue.text: Presumably for the future one follows this course

indicators.note: follows means the next piece comes after the first

parts.note: anti-past, opposed to the past, read whimsically as favouring the future
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone forward-looking chooses this course and then another follows.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is split as ANTI PAST I, a jokey reading of 'against the past'.
explanation.definitionFit: Antipasti are the Italian starters served as the first course of a meal.

clue.text: High Commission that's not easily satisfied

definitions.meaning: read literally, a lofty commission or demand
a request that is very hard to fulfil

explanation.surface: A diplomatic High Commission is hard to please.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High Commission' looks like a diplomatic mission but is a literal tall order.
explanation.definitionFit: A demanding request, hard to meet, is idiomatically called a tall order.

clue.text: Determined one has run out of truffle for cooking?

indicators.note: cooking turns raw ingredients into something new, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A determined cook has run out of truffle for the dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for cooking' rearranges OF TRUFFLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Effortful means marked by exertion and strenuous trying, as a resolute person is.

clue.text: Forest staff, perhaps, or other footballers

definitions.meaning: wardens who patrol and look after woodland
A Glasgow football club, rival to Celtic

explanation.surface: People who work at Nottingham Forest, or players at another club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forest' suggests Nottingham Forest football club; Rangers is a Scottish club.
explanation.definitionFit: Park wardens are rangers, and Glasgow Rangers is a famous Scottish club.

clue.text: Man shortly leading horse into proper place

indicators.note: leading means coming first in the answer

parts.note: Bert is a short form of names like Albert or Herbert
H is slang for heroin, which is also called horse

explanation.surface: A man briefly leads a horse into its proper place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse' is drug slang for heroin, abbreviated H.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth is a suitable position or job, as in giving a wide berth.

clue.text: He may return an unplayable serve at Wimbledon

definitions.text: He may return an unplayable serve at Wimbledon

parts.words: He may return an unplayable serve at Wimbledon
parts.note: the return sounds like a player striking back a serve, but it is a youngster collecting a fault and handing it back

explanation.surface: A tennis star returns a serve nobody could play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' sounds like the tennis shot; actually the ball is gathered and given back.
explanation.definitionFit: At tennis tournaments, children collect stray and fault balls and pass them back to the players.

clue.text: Outrage at gift from king Frank dropped

indicators.note: dropped means let fall away, so the name is removed

parts.note: frankincense was a gift of the three kings, the Magi
taken as written, a man's name

explanation.surface: Fury after a royal gift loses a man called Frank.
explanation.walkthrough: The Magi, or three kings, brought gold, frankincense and myrrh.
explanation.definitionFit: To incense someone is to make them furious.

clue.text: Chapel where bachelor has left woman

indicators.note: has left means gone away from, so the letter is removed

parts.note: Bethel is a name for a Nonconformist chapel
B is the abbreviation for bachelor, as in degrees

explanation.surface: The chapel where a bachelor has walked out on a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethel is a woman's name.

clue.text: Painting skilfully could be a source of serious income

definitions.text: could be a source of serious income

parts.note: oil is a type of painting, as in oils
well means skilfully

explanation.surface: Painting skilfully might earn an artist a lot of money.
explanation.definitionFit: A productive drilled shaft yielding crude makes its owner rich.

clue.text: Suddenly appear innocent, overturning verdict at last

indicators.note: in a down clue, overturning turns the word upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: pure means innocent

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of verdict

explanation.surface: An innocent person suddenly appears as the verdict is overturned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturning' reverses PURE to ERUP; 'at last' takes T.
explanation.definitionFit: To erupt is to burst out suddenly.

clue.text: Old priest going on about Jews' experience in Babylon

indicators.note: going on means attached after the previous piece

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the priest's name is read backwards

parts.note: Eli was the priest in the Old Testament who raised Samuel

explanation.surface: A former priest discusses the Jews' experience in Babylon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives ILE, and 'going on' attaches it after the word for former; Eli is the priest from the books of Samuel.
explanation.definitionFit: The Babylonian captivity was the forced banishment of the Jews from Judah.

clue.text: Before spring, bird-watching site is traditionally restricted

indicators.note: Before means the following piece comes first in the answer

parts.note: a hide is a shelter for watching birds
to bound is to spring or leap

explanation.surface: Before spring, a birdwatcher's hut is kept to old rules.
explanation.definitionFit: Hidebound means narrow-minded and bound by convention.

clue.text: Stupid, given 'short change in America

indicators.note: short means missing its end, so the final letter is cut

parts.note: a dime is a ten-cent coin in the US

explanation.surface: A fool is short-changed in America.
explanation.definitionFit: Dim means slow-witted.

clue.text: Yen in principle accepted in China

parts.note: Y is the abbreviation for the yen, Japan's currency
taken as written

explanation.surface: Japanese money gets accepted in China.
explanation.definitionFit: In Chinese philosophy, yin is the dark passive force paired with yang.

clue.text: Star and entourage in circulation locally

definitions.text: Star and entourage in circulation locally

parts.words: Star and entourage in circulation locally
parts.note: reads as a celebrity and followers out and about nearby, but means our Sun and its orbiting planets

explanation.surface: A celebrity and hangers-on are seen around town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' looks like a celebrity; it is the Sun, with planets circling it.
explanation.definitionFit: Our Sun and the planets orbiting it form the nearby system.
